assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM service bulletin affecting HTP-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4103 and TT-4103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 2 April 2011 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting P-4103 and TT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
